name: UNIPAC
recent: UNIPAC 近期获得两份 Petronas Carigali 海上钻井合约，并有多项重大诉讼公告。公司于 2026 年 9 月在 ACE 市场上市，首日收盘下跌 11.4%。
notable: 获得两份 Petronas Carigali 海上钻井合约。
完成 IPO 并在 ACE 市场上市，发行 1.3922 亿股新股，发行价 RM0.35。
董事及高管在 IPO 粉表配售中认购股份。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，具体内容未在标题中披露。
上市首日股价较发行价下跌 11.4%。

recent_en: UNIPAC recently secured two offshore drilling contracts from Petronas Carigali and has made several material litigation announcements. The company listed on the ACE Market in September 2026 and closed 11.4% lower on its debut.
notable_en: Secured two offshore drilling contracts from Petronas Carigali.
Completed IPO and listed on ACE Market, issuing 139.22 million new shares at RM0.35 each.
Directors and key management subscribed for shares under the IPO pink form allocation.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, details of which are not disclosed in the titles.
The share price fell 11.4% below the IPO price on the first day of listing.
